dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Heya, <$cdef(27)>! Guess what?
I just came up with a way <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>to brighten up the town!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,7)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Adivinha?
Acabei de pensar numa maneira. <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Para iluminar a cidade!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Remember how <$cdef(27)>Trubbish</color> asked ya to light a <$cdef(27)>streetlight</color>?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Lembre-se como <$cdef(27)>Trubbish</color> pediu-lhe para acender um <$cdef(27)>luz da rua</color>?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>I spotted some more <$cdef(27)>streetlights. <$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,8)>Like the ones over
that way!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,3)>Eu vi mais alguns. <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua. <$comeff(4,3)><$voicel(4,8)>Como os que acabaram
Por ali!

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,5)>I was thinkin’ we could find more <$cdef(27)>streetlights. If we
light ’em, that’ll brighten things up. Smart, right?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,5)>Eu estava pensando’ nós poderíamos encontrar mais <$cdef(27)>luzes de ruaSe nós...
luz 'em, isso vai iluminar as coisas. Inteligente, certo?

dialogues.en: <$voicel(4,7)>Let’s start by finding <$cdef(27)><dgt1;0(3)></color> <$cdef(27)>streetlights</color> and making ’em shine!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(4,7)>Vamos começar por encontrar <$cdef(27)><dgt1;0(3)></color> <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua</color> e fazê - los brilhar!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Let’s go find some <$cdef(27)>streetlights</color> to light up!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,37)><$voicel(4,9)>Vamos encontrar alguns <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua</color> Para acender!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Lighting <$cdef(27)> of them should be enough to bump up the
brightness for now, right?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,7)>Iluminação <$cdef(27)> dentre eles deve ser suficiente para aumentar o
brilho por agora, certo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Nice work, <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>I feel like it’s brighter now, thanks to all those <$cdef(27)>streetlights
you lit up!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,8)>Bom trabalho. <$cdef(27)>!
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Eu sinto que está mais brilhante agora, graças a todos aqueles <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua
Tu acendeste-te!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Think <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color> is awake now?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,1)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Pensa. <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color> Está acordado agora?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>I’m gonna check on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>. <wait(0.6)><$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,10)>You should come too!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu vou verificar <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color>. <wait(0.6)><$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,10)>Tu também devias vir!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>You think <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color> is awake? Let’s go find out!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>Achas que sim? <$cdef(27)>Snorlax</color> Está acordado? Vamos descobrir!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! Are you also here
to
check
on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>Também está aqui?
para
verificar
ligado <$cdef(27)>Snorlax?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Perhaps it’s because the town’s gotten a bit brighter, but
there’s something strange about <$cdef(27)>Snorlax now.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>Could you take a look, <$cdef(27)>?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,9)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,5)>Talvez seja porque a cidade ficou um pouco mais brilhante, mas
há algo estranho sobre <$cdef(27)>Snorlax Agora.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,7)>pode dar uma olhadela? <$cdef(27)>?

dialogues.en: Zzz... Zzznghhh...
dialogues.pt_br: Zzznghhh...

dialogues.en: <$cdef(27)>Snorlax </color>shows no signs of waking up!
dialogues.pt_br: <$cdef(27)>Snorlax </color>Não mostra sinais de acordar!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm? Nothing seems to have changed.
<$voicel(1,4)>I must have been imagining things...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Nada parece ter mudado.
<$voicel(1,4)>Eu devia estar a imaginar coisas...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Perhaps the lights in town have gone out?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Talvez as luzes da cidade se tenham apagado?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>If a Pokémon generates electricity to power up something,
like a <$cdef(27)>streetlight, <$voicel(1,6)>the electricity will run out after a while.
<$voicel(1,7)>So, if your <$cdef(27)>streetlights dim, <$voicel(1,5)>try powering them up
again, and then come back here to check on things.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Se um Pokémon gera eletricidade para alimentar alguma coisa,
como um <$cdef(27)>luz da rua, <$voicel(1,6)>A electricidade vai acabar depois de algum tempo.
<$voicel(1,7)>Então, se o seu <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua dim, <$voicel(1,5)>Tente energizá-los
Outra vez, e depois voltar aqui para verificar as coisas.

dialogues.en: Zzz... Zzznnngh... Zzzngh?
dialogues.pt_br: Zzznnngh Zzzngh?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho! The bud on their head opened up! Does that mean...
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(1,5)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,7)>O broto na cabeça deles abriu-se!

dialogues.en: Zzznghhh... Zzz... Zzzzzzz...
dialogues.pt_br: Zzznghhh... Zzzzzzzzz...

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>No, they don’t seem too likely to wake up after all.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,4)>Não, eles não parecem muito propensos a acordar, afinal.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hrmmm... Let’s see. I do feel like we were on the right
track just now...
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>I’m very curious about their flower bed-head, though.
Wait... Could it be—
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Why, yes! I believe that’s it!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hrmmm... Vamos ver. Eu sinto como se estivéssemos à direita
A pista agora mesmo...
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$voicel(1,6)>Estou muito curioso sobre a sua cabeça de cama flor, embora.
Espera, pode ser...
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>Sim, acredito que é isso!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Now listen here, <$cdef(27)>. Look closely
at
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s
flower
bed-head.
<$voicel(1,5)>It’s not fully blooming, see?
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>My gut is telling me...if you can get a whole flower garden
blooming on their head, <$voicel(1,10)>then <$cdef(27)>Snorlax will wake up!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,5)>...I presume!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,6)>Agora ouve aqui. <$cdef(27)>Olha de perto.
em
<$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s
flor
Cabeça-de-cama.
<$voicel(1,5)>Não está totalmente florescendo, vê?
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,7)>O meu instinto diz-me... se conseguires um jardim de flores inteiro
florescendo sobre a cabeça, <$voicel(1,10)>então <$cdef(27)>Snorlax Vai acordar!
<$comeff(1,10)><$voicel(1,5)>...eu presumo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Let’s see. I’m quite sure the flower bud on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s head
reacted to brightness.
<$voicel(1,7)>Which means... If we can get this town much, much
brighter, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>we’ll see a fully bloomed field of flowers!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Vamos ver. Tenho certeza que o broto de flor em <$cdef(27)>SnorlaxCabeça
reagiu ao brilho.
<$voicel(1,7)>O que significa... que se conseguirmos muito desta cidade...
mais brilhante, <$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,10)>vamos ver um campo de flores totalmente florescente!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>But, we don’t currently have enough light for that.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Try <$cdef(27)>setting up lots of bright, electricity-powered machines,
like <$cdef(27)>streetlights. <$voicel(1,8)>I think that ought to help!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas, atualmente não temos luz suficiente para isso.
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>Tenta. <$cdef(27)>instalação de muitas máquinas brilhantes, alimentadas por electricidade,
como <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua. <$voicel(1,8)>Acho que isso deve ajudar!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Here. Let’s assume that a field of flowers in full bloom is
worth <$cdef(27)>100 bloom points. In that case, I’d give <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s
flower bed-head...<$cdef(27)><$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)> bloom .
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>I’m sure it will be quite the challenge, but I hope you’ll all
work together and strive for <$cdef(27)>100 bloom points!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>And, of course, you can always come ask me if there’s
something you don’t understand!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Aqui. Vamos supor que um campo de flores em plena floração é
valor <$cdef(27)>100 pontos de flor. Nesse caso, eu daria <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s
Cabeça de cama de flor...<$cdef(27)><$emotion(1,1)><$voicel(1,8)> florescer .
<$comeff(1,10)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,9)>Tenho certeza que será um grande desafio, mas espero que todos vocês
trabalhar em conjunto e lutar por <$cdef(27)>100 pontos de flor!
<$emotion(1,8)><$voicel(1,7)>E, claro, você sempre pode vir me perguntar se há
algo que você não entende!

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Hey, <$cdef(27)>! I heard you’re trying to
make
the
town
brighter, right?

<$emotion(4,29)><$voicel(4,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Ouvi dizer que você está tentando
make
a
cidade

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>Well, guess what! I know a way to make things brighter
without using electricity!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu sei como tornar as coisas mais brilhantes.
sem usar eletricidade!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>You use <$cdef(27)>fire </color>instead! Like this!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,60)><$voicel(4,9)>Utilizar <$cdef(27)>fogo </color>Em vez disso!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>I’m sure a place like this would be bright even at night,
and might even get Pokémon who like fire <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>to show up!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Tenho certeza que um lugar como este seria brilhante mesmo à noite,
e talvez até consigam o Pokémon que gosta de fogo. <$comeff(4,9)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,8)>Aparecer!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>If you ever decide to make a place like that, please take
me with you! I can help!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Se alguma vez decidires fazer um lugar assim, por favor, toma.
Eu posso ajudar-te!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>If you ever make a place like this, please take me there!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>Se alguma vez fizeres um lugar como este, por favor leva-me lá!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>WOWWW, <$cdef(27)>! You made a
place
just
like
I asked for!

<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,9)>WOWW, <$cdef(27)>Tu fizeste um...
local
Apenas...
como
Eu pedi!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,3)>But... Gosh, I’m really sorry...
<$emotion(4,31)><$voicel(4,1)>I guess it’s not quite as bright as places with electricity...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,51)><$voicel(4,3)>Mas... Deus, eu sinto muito...
<$emotion(4,31)><$voicel(4,1)>Acho que não é tão brilhante quanto lugares com eletricidade...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Yeah, you’re right! I bet Pokémon who like warm places
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>would be really happy here!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Sim, você está certo! Eu aposto Pokémon que gosta de lugares quentes
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Seria muito feliz aqui!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>RIGHT?! Me too!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>I bet really mature, grown-up Pokémon like me would
really love this place.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,3)><$facial(4,4)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,7)>Eu também!
<$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,9)>Aposto que Pokémon, adulto e maduro como eu
Adoro este lugar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>You can come find me again anytime you wanna use fire
for something! <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>I wanna help out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,3)><$motion(4,806)><$voicel(4,7)>pode voltar a encontrar-me quando quiseres usar o fogo.
Por alguma coisa! <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Quero ajudar!

<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,7)>Oho, <$cdef(27)>! The town sure does seem
to
be
getting brighter!

para
ser
Está a ficar mais brilhante!

<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>But we still don’t have that fully bloomed field of flowers
we’d like to see on <$cdef(27)>Snorlax’s head.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,41)><$voicel(1,3)>Mas nós ainda não temos aquele campo de flores totalmente floresceu
nós gostaríamos de ver em <$cdef(27)>SnorlaxA cabeça.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>I wonder if there’s a <$cdef(27)>Pokémon somewhere who could <$cdef(27)>light

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Pergunto-me se há um <$cdef(27)>Pokémon em algum lugar que pudesse <$cdef(27)>luz
até a cidade com alguma eletricidade poderosa.

dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,5)><$facial(4,13)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,10)>Olhe! Há alguém no chão ali!

dialogues.en: <$voicel(5,10)>Oh no! You’re right! What do we do?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$voicel(5,10)>Oh não! Você está certo! O que fazemos?!

<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? What’s all the commotion? Everyone’s gathering
around something on that island.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hm? O que é toda a comoção? Todo mundo está reunindo

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>Whatever could it be? Come along then,
<$cdef(27)>!
Let’s
go
find out!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>O que é que poderia ser?
<$cdef(27)>!
Vamos
Vai.
Descobre!

<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Everyone’s gathering on that island! Let’s go see what’s

dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,3)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Todos estão se reunindo naquela ilha! Vamos ver o que é
Continuando!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>There’s someone on the ground... What happened?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,5)>Tem alguém no chão... O que aconteceu?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,58)><$voicel(4,7)>OK, food! Lessee here... Ah! All I’ve got is garbage, yo.
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,58)><$voicel(4,7)>OK, comida! Lessee aqui... Ah! Tudo que eu tenho é lixo, yo.

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Should I try to warm them up?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$facial(4,9)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,6)>Devo tentar aquecê-los?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>Goodness, where am I? And where are my little friends?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Um, pleased to make your acquaintance...I think?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,3)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,5)>E onde estão os meus amiguinhos?
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,8)>Prazer em conhecê-lo... acho eu?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah, you woke up! I’m so glad you’re unharmed!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Now, let’s see here... From the looks of you, I’d say you’re
a <$cdef(27)>Pikachu, right? An awfully pale one...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,14)><$voicel(1,5)>Ah, você acordou! Estou tão feliz que você está ileso!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,7)>Agora, vamos ver aqui... Pelo olhar de você, eu diria que você é
a <$cdef(27)>PikachuUma muito pálida...

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>I suppose you’re not wrong, my appearance is rather peaky
compared to other Pikachu... In fact, “<$cdef(27)>Peakychu” might
make for a rather charming nickname.
Pardon my asking, but where did all of YOU come from?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,6)>Eu suponho que você não está errado, minha aparência é um pouco apimentada
em comparação com outros Pikachu... Na verdade, “<$cdef(27)>Peakychu” pode
fazer para um apelido bastante encantador.
Perdoe-me a pergunta, mas de onde vieram todos vocês?

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>That’s what we’d like to ask YOU!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>We found you collapsed here all out of the blue! <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Where in
the world were you until then?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,4)>Isso é o que gostaríamos de perguntar a VOCÊ!
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Encontrámos-te a entrar em colapso aqui do nada! <$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>Em que
O mundo era você até então?

dialogues.en: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Were you hidin’ somewhere?
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,805)><$voicel(4,6)>Você estava escondido em algum lugar?

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>However DID I end up collapsed in this strange place?
<$voicel(2,4)>Hmmmmmm...
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>Apologies, I just can’t seem to remember...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,827)><$voicel(2,5)>No entanto, acabei desmaiado neste lugar estranho?
<$voicel(2,4)>Hmmmmmm...
<$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>Desculpas, eu só não consigo lembrar...

dialogues.en: <$comeff(5,5)><$facial(5,13)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,10)>Wait—do you have AMNESIA?!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(5,5)><$facial(5,13)><$motion(5,801)><$voicel(5,10)>Espere – você tem AMNESIA?!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Well, at the very least, I DO remember feeling quite tired
and falling over...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Bem, no mínimo, lembro-me de me sentir bastante cansada.
e cair...

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>I’m so sorry—I just can’t remember what happened
very well.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,3)>Eu sinto muito – eu só não consigo lembrar o que aconteceu
Muito bem.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(6,14)><$voicel(6,5)>You should totally take it easy, yo! Maybe you should
sleep a little bit if you’re feelin’ tired?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(6,14)><$voicel(6,5)>Devias ter calma, meu!
dormir um pouco se você estiver se sentindo cansado?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Why, thank you. You’re too kind.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>But it appears I’ve been sleeping for some time, so I’m
feeling quite refreshed at the moment!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,10)>Ora, obrigado. Você é muito gentil.
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,7)>Mas parece que eu tenho dormido por algum tempo, então eu estou
sentindo-se bastante revigorado no momento!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Hmmm, I see... Sounds like a complicated situation...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>I do have a favor to ask of you, though.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,5)>Estou a ver... parece uma situação complicada...
<$comeff(1,3)><$motion(1,661)><$voicel(1,7)>Mas tenho um favor para te pedir.

dialogues.en: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Oh? How can I help you?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(2,29)><$voicel(2,8)>Como posso ajudá-lo?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>This town seems to be perpetually covered by dark clouds
for some reason.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>We’ve all been working hard to brighten the place up.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(1,51)><$voicel(1,3)>Esta cidade parece estar sempre coberta por nuvens escuras.
por alguma razão.
<$emotion(1,38)><$voicel(1,7)>Todos temos trabalhado duro para iluminar o lugar.

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Why, yes—now that you mention it, it IS quite dark
around here.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,805)><$voicel(2,4)>Sim, agora que o mencionas, está bastante escuro.
Por aqui.

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>And since you’re a Pokémon who can use powerful
electricity, <$voicel(1,8)>we were really hoping you could help us out.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>What do you say?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(2)><$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,5)>E já que você é um Pokémon que pode usar poderoso
electricidade, <$voicel(1,8)>Esperávamos que nos pudesse ajudar.
<$comeff(1,6)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,6)>O que me diz?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Of course! If my power can be of any use at all, I would be
delighted to help!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>Well, without further ado...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>...Huh?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Claro! Se o meu poder pode ser de qualquer utilidade, eu seria
Prazer em ajudar!
<$facial(2,1)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,8)>Bem, sem mais delongas...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,6)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,6)>...Huh?

dialogues.en: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Hm? What seems to be the problem?
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(1,29)><$voicel(1,6)>Qual é o problema?

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Heya, <$cdef(27)>! Guess what?
I just came up with a way <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>to brighten up the town!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Olá. <$cdef(27)>Adivinha?
Acabei de pensar numa maneira. <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,8)>Para iluminar a cidade!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Remember when <$cdef(27)>Trubbish asked ya to light up a
streetlight earlier?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,6)><$motion(4,803)><$voicel(4,5)>Lembrar quando <$cdef(27)>Trubbish pediu-lhe para acender um
O semáforo mais cedo?

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(4,3)>Maybe we could find more <$cdef(27)>streetlights and light ’em.
<$voicel(4,6)>Wait... They’re already lit up.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(4,3)>Talvez possamos encontrar mais. <$cdef(27)>luzes de rua e os ilumina.
<$voicel(4,6)>Espera... Eles já estão iluminados.

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Dang, <$cdef(27)>, you already thought
of that?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>I shoulda guessed you’d be way ahead of me!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(4,14)><$voicel(4,5)>Bolas. <$cdef(27)>, já pensaste
Isso?
<$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Eu deveria ter adivinhado que você estaria muito à minha frente!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>This should be bright enough to wake up <$cdef(27)>Snorlax, right?
<$emotion(4,40)><$voicel(4,7)>I’m gonna go check up on ’em again. <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Come on,
<$cdef(27)>—let’s go!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(4,14)><$motion(4,666)><$voicel(4,5)>Isto deve ser suficientemente brilhante para acordar. <$cdef(27)>SnorlaxCerto?
<$emotion(4,40)><$voicel(4,7)>Vou dar uma olhada neles de novo. <$emotion(4,38)><$voicel(4,10)>Vamos.
<$cdef(27)>—vamos!

dialogues.en:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaa... <$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pi-pikaaa...
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Oh dear, this is quite strange...
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaaaaa...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Um... <$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>It appears as though I am no longer able to generate
electricity...
dialogues.pt_br:
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaa... <$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pi-pikaaa...
<$emotion(2,41)><$voicel(2,4)>Meu Deus, isto é muito estranho...
<$facial(2,9)><$motion(2,644)><$voicel(2,6)>Pikaaaaaa...
... ... ...
<$comeff(2,14)><$voicel(2,4)>Um... <$emotion(2,31)><$voicel(2,2)>Parece que já não sou capaz de gerar
electricidade...

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>What?! But <$cdef(27)>Pikachu are known for wielding incredible
electricity <$voicel(1,8)>and even summoning thunderbolts!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,10)>What exactly is going on?!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,13)><$motion(1,803)><$voicel(1,9)>O quê? <$cdef(27)>Pikachu são conhecidos por empunhar incrível
electricidade <$voicel(1,8)>e até mesmo raios de raios!
<$comeff(1,6)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,666)><$voicel(1,10)>O que está acontecendo exatamente?!

dialogues.en:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>What, indeed... I’m just as shocked as you are. I’m so sorry.
It doesn’t look like I’ll be able to aid you at all like this.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$emotion(2,51)><$voicel(2,3)>O que, de fato... Estou tão chocado quanto você. Sinto muito.
Não parece que eu vou ser capaz de ajudá-lo em tudo assim.

dialogues.en:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Nonsense! We’d still be very grateful for your aid.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Right now, we need any help we can get from any
Pokémon.
dialogues.pt_br:
<$motion(1,807)><$voicel(1,5)>Bobagem! Nós ainda seríamos muito gratos por sua ajuda.
<$comeff(1,14)><$motion(1,824)><$voicel(1,7)>Neste momento, precisamos de qualquer ajuda que possamos obter de qualquer
Pokémon.

dialogues.en:
<$voicel(1,5)>And on top of that, <$cdef(27)> here has
some
sort
of
mysterious power.
<$voicel(1,7)>It’s possible that just by spending time with them, you may
recover your electricity. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>And remember the past too!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$voicel(1,5)>E além disso, <$cdef(27)> aqui tem
alguns
sort
de
Poder misterioso.
<$voicel(1,7)>É possível que apenas por passar tempo com eles, você pode
Recupera a tua electricidade. <$comeff(1,10)><$facial(1,4)><$motion(1,664)><$voicel(1,10)>E lembre-se do passado também!

dialogues.en:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Thank you... Right! There’s no use moping about!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>While I don’t know HOW exactly I can help right now,
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>I shall do my very best to be of assistance!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>It’s lovely to meet you all!
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comcan(1)><$emotion(2,8)><$voicel(2,9)>Obrigado... Certo! Não adianta se lamentar!
<$comeff(2,14)><$motion(2,666)><$voicel(2,5)>Enquanto eu não sei exatamente como posso ajudar agora,
<$emotion(2,60)><$voicel(2,9)>Farei o meu melhor para ajudar!
<$comeff(2,9)><$motion(2,806)><$voicel(2,8)>É um prazer conhecê-los a todos!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Nice to meetcha!
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(4,8)><$voicel(4,10)>Prazer em conhecê-lo!

dialogues.en: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>From today on, we’re FRIENDS! ♪
dialogues.pt_br: <$emotion(5,38)><$voicel(5,10)>De hoje em diante, somos AMIGOS!

dialogues.en: <$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,10)>I love makin’ friends! The more the merrier, yo!
dialogues.pt_br: <$comeff(6,9)><$facial(6,4)><$motion(6,806)><$voicel(6,10)>Eu amo fazer amigos! Quanto mais melhor, yo!

dialogues.en:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,6)>Gadzooks! A Pokémon’s collapsed on the ground!
<$cdef(27)>, could you go check on them?
dialogues.pt_br:
<$comeff(1,5)><$facial(1,1)><$motion(1,665)><$voicel(1,6)>Gadzooks! Um Pokémon caiu no chão!
<$cdef(27)>Pode ir vê-los?
